index.citableQuestion: What is included in iShine's IPL manufacturing services?
index.citableParagraph: iShine provides end-to-end IPL manufacturing services for private-label programs, covering OEM/ODM development, product design, production and assembly, packaging, and export logistics. A typical engagement starts with requirements and positioning, then moves into engineering decisions such as cooling approach (including premium sapphire contact cooling targeting ~10°C in supported configurations), energy range, flash window sizing, wavelength filtering, and safety interlocks. Platform-based prototype sampling can often begin in 1-4 weeks depending on scope, while programs involving tooling, electronics, firmware, or compliance work add time for validation, documentation, and production planning. Packaging support includes branded cartons, inserts, manuals, labeling, and accessory selection aligned to retail, distributor, or e-commerce channels, with options such as manual localization and channel-ready labeling. Delivery support includes export documents and shipping coordination (FOB Shenzhen, with CIF options) by sea, air, or courier based on timeline and destination requirements.

faq.title: Questions brands ask before placing an order
faq.description: Short answers with direct links to the relevant service pages.

items.question: Do you offer No MOQ for private-label IPL programs?
items.answer: Yes. Many programs can start with smaller pilot orders so you can validate positioning and demand before scaling. For details, see No MOQ support.

items.question: Can you print our logo on the device and accessories?
items.answer: Yes. We support production-ready logo application methods and help confirm placement and durability expectations before mass production.

items.question: Can you customize the box, inserts, and barcodes for retail channels?
items.answer: Yes. We can customize cartons, internal protection inserts, and channel labeling requirements, including barcode placement and master carton planning.

items.question: Do you provide multilingual user manuals and quick-start guides?
items.answer: Yes. We can customize manuals and quick-start guides with clear diagrams, warnings, and localization support to reduce returns and support load.

items.question: Do you support packaging and export logistics?
items.answer: Yes. We support kitting, labeling, export documents, and shipping coordination for sea, air, or courier based on destination requirements.

items.question: Do you support dropshipping directly to customers?
items.answer: Yes. We can support direct-to-customer dispatch with defined packaging rules, order handling workflows, and tracking synchronization.

items.question: How do we choose the best IPL model for our market?
items.answer: Start by matching your target segment to a platform: cooling comfort, energy positioning, app connectivity, portability, and packaging goals. Then confirm the customization scope and compliance needs.

items.question: What are the next steps after we choose a model?
items.answer: Typical next steps are: confirm requirements, sample evaluation, finalize branding and packaging assets, then plan production and shipping.
